g.text: 4-CHANNEL RELAY OPTICAL GALVANIC ISOLATION WIRING SCHEMATIC
ESP32 30-Pin Dev Board | Optocoupled 4-Relay Board (Songle SRD-05VDC-SL-C) | Dedicated 5V Coil Supply | AC Mains & RC Snubbers
Powers 5V Relay Coils Only - Strictly Isolated Ground Plane
1. NO ESP32 GND CONNECTION! Zero common ground plane.
2. ESP32 3.3V powers optocoupler infrared LEDs only (~5mA per ch).
3. External 5V 2A supply powers electromagnetic coils via JD-VCC.
✓ Inrush surges & EMI cannot physically reach ESP32 GPIOs!
AC MAINS LOAD SWITCHING & RC SNUBBER PROTECTION
RC Snubber Suppresses Contact Arcing & Back-EMF
Protects relay contacts from pitting and prevents inductive voltage spikes from resetting ESP32
